programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #24
programme.desc: 守仁做出宣言:「我明天!終於要開始洗衣服了!」。原來他心愛的牛仔褲已經穿了一年,現在要開始進行二次洗滌了。妮可和監志很清楚守仁的個性,他只要一扯到喜歡的東西馬上就會開始長篇大論起來。但第一次見到守仁這樣的見晴卻不小心對守仁說「也請教教我牛仔褲的事吧」……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #25
programme.desc: 「翌檜祭」就快要開始了。妮可等人的班級決定利用妮可個性強烈的魔法打造能在充滿妖怪的店內享受一段奇妙時光的主題咖啡店「鬧鬼咖啡店」。在大家忙著準備的過程中,文化祭實行委員來拜託妮可在閉幕典禮上使用魔法。另一方面,監志邀守仁一起在演藝舞台上表演漫才。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #93
programme.desc: 亞連來到「14號祕密房間」,當他站在眼前的鋼琴前方時,雙手隨著腦中浮現的旋律擅自彈奏了起來。目瞪口呆的他接到克勞斯的聯絡,對方指示他操縱方舟並懷著心願彈琴。不明白指示含義的亞連感到更加困惑,但他決定相信奇蹟,一心想著自身願望並彈奏鍵盤。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #18
programme.desc: 小茜自幼因憧憬佳奈而投身於演藝事業。然而,擺在她跟前的卻是無情的現實…從那以來,小茜就不斷磨練自我。而現在,她引領而望的決勝時刻終於到來!

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #19
programme.desc: 佳奈為了在演藝圈生存下去,選擇成為了一個聽話的演員。然而阿奎亞卻在背後推了她一把…!?另一方面,越是享受演戲就越是會引發恐慌症的阿奎亞,他所選擇的唯一一個應對方法是…

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #20
programme.desc: 阿奎亞回憶著過去的痛苦回憶,利用其悲傷情緒做出情感演技。懊悔、傷心以及那無法挽回、無法實現的美夢…阿奎亞用盡一切的一切,來詮釋眼前角色的心境…!

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #21
programme.desc: 阿奎亞向姬川說出經過親緣DNA鑑定後,他們是同父異母兄弟的結果。然而姬川卻說出了更為驚人的事實…。另一方面,露比等人的B小町將要開始新的活動…!?

programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #20
programme.desc: 阿奎亞回憶著過去的痛苦回憶,利用其悲傷情緒做出情感演技。懊悔、傷心以及那無法挽回、無法實現的美夢…阿奎亞用盡一切的一切,來詮釋眼前角色的心境…!

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #21
programme.desc: 阿奎亞向姬川說出經過親緣DNA鑑定後,他們是同父異母兄弟的結果。然而姬川卻說出了更為驚人的事實…。另一方面,露比等人的B小町將要開始新的活動…!?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #94
programme.desc: 方舟藉由亞連彈奏的旋律奇蹟似地重生。亞連一行人與失散的神田和柯洛利重逢後感到欣喜若狂。然而喜出望外的可不只他們,一直在為眾人的安危祈禱的中國分部和本部的成員也同樣喜形於色!

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #95
programme.desc: 黑教團本部因亞連等人的回歸而興奮不已。然而在歡樂的氣氛中有人卻來潑冷水,由中央廳派遣的特別監察瑪耳歌姆C魯貝里亞召開了克勞斯的詢問會議。在此會議上,克勞斯過去的種種惡劣行為被一一舉出,但他本人卻淡然地置若罔聞,不理會對方。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-唔做黑幫做牧師
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《豐盛的生命》。

programme.desc: 復興教會 講題:展現得勝生命 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 王一平牧師-一言道破
programme.desc: 王一平牧師全新講道系列︰一言道破,以精闢的教導,讓你重新認識敬拜、恩典、事奉、平安的涵意,讓聖靈重新提醒我們,怎樣做一個真基督徒。

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 《聖經》實戰攻略
programme.desc: 節目按不同主題,包括︰職場、家庭、戀愛、情緒、信仰生命,邀請七位牧者從《聖經》經文結合生活例子與大家一同靈修,建立一個不離地的信徒生命。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-唔做黑幫做牧師
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 靈修早晨

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會-森美、蔣麗萍
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。 雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。 流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血﹑淚﹑性命寫成的感人見證! 今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢? 李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

鳳凰洲際快車 (291225)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰洲際快車》是鳳凰衛視子夜時段的新聞資訊節目,為您帶來兩岸三地,以及國際社會的大小新聞、最新動態和局勢發展。

programme.title: 文化大觀園 (453)
programme.desc: 《文化大觀園》:節目關注中華文化中的大事件、大歷史、大人物和新發現,在紛繁的生活中給您清靜、雅致的空間,並通過我們的鏡頭去探尋中華文明中充滿迷幻、離奇的人物和故事。

programme.title: 鳳凰大健康 (366)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰大健康》:節目將由來自中西醫的健康科普專家和全球首個“智能醫生組成健康科普主持團,並將每期邀請一位頂級醫療專家作為嘉賓,集合中西的理論精華,配合妙趣橫生的人工智慧互動對熱點的健康科普話題進行權

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 (1366)
programme.desc: 《紀錄大時代》:紀錄珍貴片段,重溫精彩大時代,《紀錄大時代》為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片,把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前。

programme.title: 香港新視點 (486)
programme.desc: 《香港新視點》是透過訪問特區政府官員、學者、焦點事件的相關人物,以及採訪兩地的年輕人的交流團等,讓觀眾透徹了解香港以至內地政治文化,加深對國情的認識。

programme.title: 名人面對面 (440)
programme.desc: 《名人面對面》:主持人專訪神州各地英傑,旁敲側擊,使觀眾如親歷其境,與名人共度珍貴一刻,感受最細膩的時間。

programme.title: 築夢天下 (461)
programme.desc: 《築夢天下》尋找中外不同風格的建築、民居,道出背後的環境因素和地理條件,詳述生活於其間的人物,細訴人和建築之間糾纏不清的故事。

programme.title: 香港熱廚房 (69)
programme.desc: 《香港熱廚房》是鳳凰衛視中文台《解碼香港》升級版,資深評論員程介南先生,邀請香港政經圈共聚熱廚房,取時事當食材,以此喻彼,見微知著,以創意為廚藝,化深厚為火候,庖丁解牛,分析解碼。

programme.title: 近觀中國 (205)

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 粉紅之城齋浦爾以印度人最喜愛的藍色陶瓷聞名 獨一無二的手工藝品, 是送禮的上品 隨著平價的工廠製陶器引入而一度銷聲匿跡的藍陶, 全靠印度的代表藝術家克里帕爾令它復活, 這份珍貴的文化遺產材得以流傳至今

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 置身里斯本山城，不想迷路，芷珮建議先從市中心廣場出發，乘搭電車亦不錯。想一展美術天分？可到特定規劃的公眾地方合法塗鴉，看看芷珮和兩子創意無限的傑作！潮人芷珮到活化工廠區，大吃多款雞菜式；閒逛由紡織廠改建的復古書店，變身文青。即興短遊西班牙名城西維爾，在地標西班牙廣場打卡後，芷珮登上小艇，圍繞廣場浪漫「遊船河」；再走上木製藝術建築最高點，Chill爆欣賞夕陽。芷珮品嚐葡式國民美食豬排包，立食也滋味！

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 灣仔區經過多年發展，新舊文化共冶一爐，衛志豪、譚嘉儀、謝東閔一次過遊遍區內不同年代特色景點。於鬧市欣賞維港日落景緻，感覺浪漫寫意。三人走進香港故事館，從懷舊展品中尋找港人的拼搏痕跡。深入80年歷史露天市集，貼地感受灣仔街坊人情味。日式海鮮市場每日引進新鮮食材，刺身愛好者必然食指大動。經典大牌檔面臨絕跡，三人從香滑奶茶中細味過去60載輝煌點滴。嘉儀拿起結他在姻緣石前大唱情歌，莫非她在呼喚愛情來臨？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 名人馬斯克除了是世界首富，還兼具多重身分。谷主們都對其人生故事充滿好奇，並設題討論。凱婷概述馬斯克的成長經歷與發跡過程，原來他曾被幼稚園校長認為智力發展遲緩！對於AI會否取代人類工作，凱文、泳嘉各有不同看法。馬斯克於推動AI發展影響深遠，但他曾在演講中直言AI是人類最大的生存威脅？三位谷主還會談論對馬斯克的深刻印象，泳嘉、凱文分別引述其金句，勉勵大家勇於面對挫折，凱婷則談到馬斯克的非一般營商理念。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 海藻掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 海藻越來越受歡迎，其多樣性不斷給美食家帶來驚喜。無論它們是因為營養特性、碘化風味還是美觀而受到追捧，它們都注定會征服世界。我們將踏上一段旅程，追尋這些特殊海藻的足跡。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 謝采芝藉一叮舞台追尋歌手夢，惟被指揀錯歌，她再唱一曲，為「復活」最後一拼！黃紫恩、劉展霆一拍即合，以性感火辣舞蹈引來陣陣尖叫，有人竟將焦點放在黑絲上……方紹聰、關嘉敏大膽挑戰棟篤笑，卻陷入被叮絕境，遂加碼展示Beatbox、Rap唱才藝，能否「重生」？在媽媽現場打氣下，陳懿德變身「女神」獻聲，自信心大增。入行逾廿載的劉家聰，戰勝重病歸來，冀以手影故事重獲觀眾掌聲；其女兒驚喜上台給予鼓勵，場面催淚！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 股評人胡孟青經常要不分晝夜地留意各地波動的股市，情緒亦易有起伏，隨時影響睡眠質素。青姐笑言豐滿身型源於喜歡吃喝，其減壓妙法是用餐或消閒時遠離「行家」，適當時機還要學懂放下！聆聽ASMR錄音、輕鬆音樂，均可幫助入睡，但原來經過慎選，「噪音」亦可助眠？註冊音樂治療師細說白噪音與粉紅噪音的分類。除聽覺外，透過嗅覺感受香薰的味道，也可舒緩緊張。而複方精油的功效更可以是單方的六倍，不妨參考香薰治療師的意見。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，兒童體適能教練為大家準備了兩樽水，首先指導眾人接受需要負重的上肢肌力訓練。經過四個動作，主持姐姐已感到手臂酸軟。不過，當教練詢問可要加操時，前來參與的小朋友隨即點頭答應，展現滿滿鬥志。稍事休息後，教練接着帶淶下肢協調訓練，包括模仿企鵝般以腳跟走路、青蛙跳等動作，趣味十足。「動物好萌友」環節，則引領觀眾認識世界第二大企鵝品種— 國王企鵝。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 大停電仍然持續，所有依靠電力的東西都無法使用。暖爐用煤油與車用汽油陷入短缺，連食物也成為搶奪對象。智悟發現沈武私下走入洞穴，追蹤下才發現沈武打算製作生物燃料，駕車前往風力發電站，嘗試恢復全鎮的電力。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子與姐姐參加社區舉辦的聖誕聯歡會，有機會與區內小孩聚首一堂，亦因此看到大人的種種窘態。小丸子在繪畫比賽獲獎，在全校集會上獲頒獎狀，卻在等候上台時人有三急，令她不知如何是好。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
中國建築呈獻：2025國際大事回顧粵
programme.desc: 中美元首釜山會面，穩定全球最重要的雙邊關係。日本、南韓、泰國政壇相繼變天。其中日本選出的首位女首相高市早苗，發表涉台錯誤言論，令中日關係緊張。法國巴黎羅浮宮珠寶失竊案，震驚全球。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 伯伯疑於藥房店員誘導下，出示身份證讓對方查看醫療券餘額，更幾乎購入海味。事件反映長者未必清楚醫療券使用詳情，或會被誤導購物。屋苑單位天花滴水，蓋頂燈罩變水盤！樓上業主對處理欠積極，事主投訴經年不果。單位於十二月初因滲水蔓延全屋而停電，專家檢驗後判斷單位不宜居住，事主擔憂隨時觸電或發生爆炸，惟哭訴無門……經典劇集電影版公映，主要演員古天樂、宣萱細談箇中點滴。《中年好聲音4》一百強陸續亮聲，帶來花絮。

programme.title: 東華三院善道同行粵
programme.desc: 眾藝員分兩隊參與競技賽，為踏入155周年、行善無界限的東華三院籌款。比拼後還合力疊高紙箱，務求籌得更多善款。陳庭欣、何泳芍、朱文慧出海滑水籌款，除了斟茶、寫字、轉呼拉圈，更出動教練滑住水跳繩，神乎奇技。大男孩蕭正楠、馬貫東則聯同「東華」小學生，透過射龍門籌款，幾難都要全中！此外，港姐冠軍陳詠詩擅長體操，要在移動中的車輛上完成動作，又會如何？還有袁偉豪駕駛越野電單車行平衡木、斜台飛車，既驚險又精彩！

programme.title: 使徒行者2諜影行動粵PG
programme.desc: 一份暗網的解鎖信息，令警界陷入前所未有的恐慌。為保護證據，警司程滔陷入危機，其師父葉志帆與兄弟井進賢亦因此交惡。警界內部敵友難分。隨著深入調查，一個多年來隱於幕後的恐怖組織漸漸浮出水面…

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 來自約旦的空手道世界冠軍艾查法利，早前來港出席交流會，向本港運動員與愛好者傳授經驗和技巧。摔跤新星宋樹仁為港爭光，勇奪日本青少年級別賽事冠軍。這位年僅十二歲的小將分享深刻點滴，並盼未來可更進一步。香港公開劍擊錦標賽召集本地好手同場比拼，張家朗、蔡俊彥等港將也有參與。網球冠軍盃邀請多地雙打精英，在室內賽場較技，戰況如何？

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中國建築呈獻：2025財經大事回顧粵
programme.desc: 四月關稅戰開打衝擊全球貿易；出口疲弱、內需力度不足，加上地方債惡化，繼續困擾中國經濟；疫後本地經濟溫和復蘇、新股市場暢旺，但餐飲零售經營仍然充滿變數，2025財經大事回顧會和大家重溫過去一年，本港和環球財經市場的重要事件。

programme.title: 新鮮人#21粵
programme.desc: 家輝認為不能姑息韋權，遂與麗華報警。家謙欲向鋼琴大師于漸秀拜師，卻被琴行導師處處為難。阮盈從美國回來，更騙家謙已康復，但其實阮盈剛生了腫瘤。麗華不適，家輝細心照顧，麗華感動。家謙從錄影帶中苦練琴技，已能將艱深樂章背熟，家輝、麗華及家謙皆努力地朝自己目標前進。阮盈發覺家謙真正所愛的人其實是韋文，悄然返美。家輝參賽圖則被RAYMOND造手腳，不能入圍。家謙學琴的琴行被人踢館，要找出雙方學生進行比試。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 伯伯疑於藥房店員誘導下，出示身份證讓對方查看醫療券餘額，更幾乎購入海味。事件反映長者未必清楚醫療券使用詳情，或會被誤導購物。屋苑單位天花滴水，蓋頂燈罩變水盤！樓上業主對處理欠積極，事主投訴經年不果。單位於十二月初因滲水蔓延全屋而停電，專家檢驗後判斷單位不宜居住，事主擔憂隨時觸電或發生爆炸，惟哭訴無門……經典劇集電影版公映，主要演員古天樂、宣萱細談箇中點滴。《中年好聲音4》一百強陸續亮聲，帶來花絮。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 灣仔區經過多年發展，新舊文化共冶一爐，衛志豪、譚嘉儀、謝東閔一次過遊遍區內不同年代特色景點。於鬧市欣賞維港日落景緻，感覺浪漫寫意。三人走進香港故事館，從懷舊展品中尋找港人的拼搏痕跡。深入80年歷史露天市集，貼地感受灣仔街坊人情味。日式海鮮市場每日引進新鮮食材，刺身愛好者必然食指大動。經典大牌檔面臨絕跡，三人從香滑奶茶中細味過去60載輝煌點滴。嘉儀拿起結他在姻緣石前大唱情歌，莫非她在呼喚愛情來臨？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 名人馬斯克除了是世界首富，還兼具多重身分。谷主們都對其人生故事充滿好奇，並設題討論。凱婷概述馬斯克的成長經歷與發跡過程，原來他曾被幼稚園校長認為智力發展遲緩！對於AI會否取代人類工作，凱文、泳嘉各有不同看法。馬斯克於推動AI發展影響深遠，但他曾在演講中直言AI是人類最大的生存威脅？三位谷主還會談論對馬斯克的深刻印象，泳嘉、凱文分別引述其金句，勉勵大家勇於面對挫折，凱婷則談到馬斯克的非一般營商理念。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 粉紅之城齋浦爾以印度人最喜愛的藍色陶瓷聞名 獨一無二的手工藝品, 是送禮的上品 隨著平價的工廠製陶器引入而一度銷聲匿跡的藍陶, 全靠印度的代表藝術家克里帕爾令它復活, 這份珍貴的文化遺產材得以流傳至今

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 主持與梁嘉琪到訪九龍城，找尋足以令人「嘩」一聲的美食。甚麼美食能令喬寶寶破了戒也不知？打開九龍城區「覓食懶人包」。自製全牛、全豬、全海鮮宴，發掘新鮮感。孫慧雪作出環球美食推介，吃盡雪糕、點心、爐端燒。

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 要快速處理粟米、薯仔、青瓜、蝦等沙律食材，陳敏之有小貼士「醒醒」大家！為何切青瓜時要貼一支牙籤在刀邊？想將食物真空保存，一大缸水便足夠？嚴選五大網球趣怪用途，網球隨時變身零錢包、掛架及按摩器！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 主婦學會極速執屋大法，變出空餘時間！摺被、燙衣有甚麼加速建議？江美儀帶來黑絲襪，可清潔甚麼？道破黑色、紅色廁所泵之別。利用「切絲」膠手套發揮智慧，解決生活問題。切洋蔥前做甚麼工夫可避免「流淚」？

programme.title: 成長吧！大熊貓粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦中國大熊貓保護研究中心四川臥龍神樹坪基地2021年新生的四隻熊貓寶寶及它們的飼養員們，以“視頻日記”的記錄方式，以全外景拍攝熊貓寶寶的成長過程。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 星夢頻道突然出現「神秘偶像驚喜出道」的倒數。連DearCrown和Prism Stone也不知道的新偶像登場，讓閃亮宿的氣氛興高采烈。奇蹟閃耀組和Meltic StAr、Ring Marry一起為新人做暖場節目，而倒數過後，登台亮相的新偶像竟是……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 突然間，Prism Stone和DearCrown的店面變得像火焰般閃耀，就在這時，自稱鳳凰蒙面俠神秘人物突然出現，她還企圖憑著一己喜好，令閃亮宿所有事物都染上鳳凰色。為了阻止鳳凰蒙面俠這個野心，未來一行對她展開追捕。

programme.desc: 踏入2025年，本港復蘇的步伐仍然未明朗，結業潮持續，部分行業失業率攀升，加上關稅戰等因素，衝擊本港經濟。而下半年皇后山食水含瀝青微粒，政府採購鑫鼎鑫冒牌飲用水，大埔宏福苑五級火多人死傷，一再考驗政府應變能力。今年亦是港區國安法實施五周年，多宗國安案件都有結果，不少政黨及民間團體宣告解散，但政府指國安風險仍未解除。年底立法會換屆選舉，多名新人上任，能否為香港管治帶來新氣象？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵

programme.desc: 港區百強比拼延續，美甲師呼喊<I’ll always love you，卻「控訴」周國豐令她留下陰影？家庭主婦以<女神亮相，並提到舞台既熟悉又陌生，原來曾是新秀冠軍人馬。配音員帶來抒情英文歌，還想藉比賽與吳大強相認？銀行從業員化身<俏郎君，令谷婭溦猶豫應否撳燈。行政助理憑英文歌直接晉級，張佳添點評值九十分以上，往後表現引人期待。來自馬來西亞的三孩之母以另類搖滾曲目，讓評審隨着歌聲，投入擺動。

programme.title: 華潤集團呈獻：無窮之路V — 智行無疆粵普
programme.desc: 從百度「文心一言」大模型的技術突破，到AI走入人類的生活； 盲人程式編寫員鍾科借AI之眼“看見”代碼，在程式世界裡獲得前所未有的自由。上海體育學院的體育大模型，助力精英運動員在國際賽事奪金。商湯科技讓文物在AI中“復活”，這一集將見證科技如何打破身體限制，為每個人創造平等機會。

programme.title: 星展豐盛理財呈獻:一周星星粵PG
programme.desc: 一部經典劇集，為何要等逾廿年才等到電影版？宣萱、林峯、朱鑑然都將視線移向古天樂，由身兼電影監製的他親自解答。朱仔「新加入」，更有一份神奇莫名的感覺！宣萱乍聽個別角色的英文名字，大表驚訝，阿峯坦言要靠網民抽絲剝繭。傳聞世上只有宣萱能夠對住古生嗆話，從訪問細節已可獲印證。主持區永權的提問，又可會犯到禁忌而令對方反白眼？不過，區爸無所畏懼，公開播放某演唱會的脫衣唱歌片段，並要古生回應當年兼任歌手的決定。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 滷水鵝是不少人心目中的潮州代表菜式，並大多是選用體型龐大兼肉嫩多汁的獅頭鵝炮製。三位主持前往獅頭鵝養殖場，從源頭了解美味秘密，德哥順道分享揀鵝心得。與嘉賓薛家燕一同享用全鵝宴，奉客的頭盤「鵝掌凍」完全吃不到骨骼，原來是分子料理；「滷老鵝頭」，三姐稱口感像花膠！陳年滷水亦可充當火鍋湯底，烚煮鵝心等食材，別具風味。在鵝場旁，三姐就地取材烹調「涼瓜燜鵝掌翼」、「西紅茄鵝雜煮鵝蛋」等，端出最新鮮的真味。

programme.desc: 置身里斯本山城，不想迷路，芷珮建議先從市中心廣場出發，乘搭電車亦不錯。想一展美術天分？可到特定規劃的公眾地方合法塗鴉，看看芷珮和兩子創意無限的傑作！潮人芷珮到活化工廠區，大吃多款雞菜式；閒逛由紡織廠改建的復古書店，變身文青。即興短遊西班牙名城西維爾，在地標西班牙廣場打卡後，芷珮登上小艇，圍繞廣場浪漫「遊船河」；再走上木製藝術建築最高點，Chill爆欣賞夕陽。芷珮品嚐葡式國民美食豬排包，立食也滋味！

programme.title: 香港本色粵

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺巧妙奉上「一魚兩味」，先把大魚魚腩蒸熟拆肉，配合柴魚湯底、勝瓜絲、木耳絲等，煮出鮮甜足料的「拆魚羹」。魚頭則下鑊香煎，是為甘香惹味的「煎焗魚脊」。火龍果品種多、營養高，白肉、紅肉、紫水晶各有捧場客，另有同科的麒麟果，阿譚分享選「果」心得。火龍果不單能生吃，還可入饌？鼎爺秘製「紫水晶咕嚕肉」，色彩繽紛、酸甜醒胃！此外，鼎爺、阿譚在順德享用當地名菜「豉汁蒸鯪魚嘴」和「釀鯪魚」，並道出箇中美味精髓。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 腎臟的主要功能包括過濾血液中的代謝廢物、調節水分平衡等。臨床腫瘤科醫生詳析相關診治資訊，提醒吸煙、肥胖等都是腎癌高危因素，如出現血尿或持續的腰腹部疼痛，應及早求醫。疊杯是一項講求速度與手眼協調的競技運動，總會主席為觀眾介紹比賽細節，還有同來的兩位香港代表隊成員分享參賽經驗與深刻賽事。二人更即席示範表演，並指導主持實際試玩，表現如何？「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓以龍蝦配鱸魚炮製「水晶龍王盤」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓李佳芯與陸永，以及C君迎來首個難題，究竟經常啪關節可會受傷？陸永、C君分別從揼骨經驗解謎；佳芯對啪關節導致手指變粗的顧慮，又可有根據？有請風濕病科專科醫生現身說法。嘌呤是引致痛風惡化的「元兇」！佳芯、C君分別找出可令痛風惡化的日常食物與用品，啤酒、能量飲品、跌打酒同上榜。醫生細說痛風的嚴重性，甚或會影響腎臟，形成痛風石等，後患無窮。營養師亦帶來適合痛風患者的果汁，嘉賓能嚐出當中的四種水果嗎？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#25粵PG
programme.desc: 駿昇願出五億酬金，只要美詩能令柏義承認殺人，美詩為錢而答應。駿昇認為只要救到林磊才能取得公司控制權，冠一不以為然。一班老千在賭場不停贏錢，駿昇私下捉拿老千並報警，事後警告柏義不要再用老千詐取賭場資金。柏義為對付冠一而煩惱，柔紫的話竟啟發了他。其西發現兆良到來石澳，擔心他為報仇而來，正花卻主動找他講清楚。冠一知道美詩難以在柏義身上套料，決定主動出擊，豈料美詩突然倒戈，天龍又現身阻止他，並帶走柏義。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 春天和暖令小丸子老是賴床，小丸子打聽有何方法令自己順利起床，並發現花輪教的播音樂方法十分有效。小丸子重新開始集郵，獲高丸太太贈送一袋外國郵票，誰知卻在裡面發現一張印刷歪斜的版票。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 珍珠由貝類孕育而成，原來香港亦有出產。養殖場負責人攜來港產珍珠亮相「Kids’ Notes」，並提到早於五代十國時期，香港已有採珠記載。但早年除了要面對水下危機，過度採捕更令行業一度中斷。嘉賓詳述養殖珍珠的工作與細節，還即場示範開殼取珠。瀅仴姐姐好奇剩下的貝肉如何處理，除可製成調味醬料，還能加工成珍珠末、護膚產品。嘉賓亦指養殖珍珠有助淨化海洋，詳情如何？另外，本集也會播放AI生成動畫《狐假虎威》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 小夫用奇珍異獸作為觀察日記的題材，大家也想仿傚，多啦A夢用「動物暫住咭」把奇珍異獸請到家中。明天去露營，但天氣預報顯示會下雨，大雄跟小夫打賭會放晴，他胸有成竹，皆因有法寶「天氣箱」。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 樓價持續回升，帶動業主獲利機會增加，沙田一個老牌屋苑，近期不少成交均有錢賺，樓價處於甚麼水平？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2712粵
programme.desc: 凌凌回港，得知導演堅慌病倒，主動頂替他拍攝《揸流灘》，Bonnie大為感激。凌凌提出不少意見，Bonnie於沒法推搪的情況下才允許他改動某一場戲，原來Bonnie亦有為難之處。城安獲Bonnie告知劇組的苦況，遂嘗試幫忙解決問題，為此作出不少努力，卻事與願違。其後，凌凌再提出特別的拍攝要求，城安決意要向凌凌道出真相，但未能付諸實行。此時，Bonnie對凌凌終於忍無可忍……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻：守誠者#10粵PG
programme.desc: 何浩輝找到鑒證科的石sir想要看到程沛德驗屍報告，通過分析得知阿德在當天跟哥哥打架前，還跟別人發生過肢體衝突。經過對街坊的詢問，何浩輝得知出事當天阿德似乎與人在小巷內起了衝突，來到小巷尋找監控。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 戲陽與一笑見面，在城中閒逛時遇到隨歌及靜石；隨歌擅自寫信給靜炎請求讓靜石入贅夙砂，一笑問未然關於平陵之戰那天的事，發現未然說謊，一笑得知平陵一戰當晚有人假冒客商跟靜石見面，靜炎答應入贅之事…

programme.title: 尚品花膠專門店呈獻:東張今年大件事2025粵
programme.desc: 「報東張」這三個字已經變得深入民心，許多市民遇到各式各樣難題、看不過眼的事情，就會「報東張」。如果鄰居是囤積狂，甚至誇張得門口也進不去，《東張西望》團隊會聯繫義工幫忙執拾清理，也關心戶主的心理需要。2025年曾獲跟進改善的幾位垃圾屋主人，現時生活如何？性格有甚麼轉變？報料不需排隊，但過往到運輸署辦牌照相關事宜，有可能要與謀利的排隊黨「大戰」一番。經《東張西望》報道後，情況可有改善？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#11粵PG
programme.desc: 卓萬向心蘭提出要娶子君為四姨太，心蘭痛心。卓萬要求爾嫣負責監督子君新房的裝修，爾嫣答允。啟燊向父親表示全家人都因他要娶子君而不高興，自己亦不認同父親的做法；啟燁與啟燊討論，啟燁提醒兄長應了解子君感受。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#5粵
programme.desc: 大廈電梯緊急維修，溢滿提議跑樓梯回家，眾家人借故推塘。溢滿近日行為「失常」，全是為了參加馬拉松作準備，贏取冠軍獎品，與藥房伙計混熟，是要他們冒名參加比賽增加勝算。不過比賽當日有朋等出現令溢滿好夢成空。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#15粵普
programme.desc: 丹陽在十一娘的提點下，識破了蓮房的詭計，並明白到最重要的是與令寬的夫妻之情；誡哥過繼給二房，令寬很感激十一娘；十一娘發現琥珀向羅大太太通風報信，並未責怪，仍待之以誠；令宜受十一娘影響，對家人越發寬容。

programme.title: 逆轉女王(完)
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時(完)
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Cartoon following four adventure-seeking superheroes as they explore exciting places all around the world.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Fancy Restaurant
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey want mum and dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan, until chef Bingo's special arrives.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Dusky Leaf Monkey
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Malaysia, South East Asia on a baby animal mission to find out why new born dusky leaf monkeys look so different to their parents.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S1) - Mission: Bandage Team
programme.desc: Sylvie the therapy dog helps a little boy called Ben feel brave enough to see the doctor.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild (S1) - Cassowary and Gharial
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet a flightless bird called a cassowary. Then, they watch the Sunda gharial crocodilian being fed some fish and reveal an amazing connection they have with the cassowary.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Towel
programme.desc: Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Favourite Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is, but have trouble deciding their own favourites.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and pal Rodeo Horse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Game Show Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Puffin Patrol, Iceland
programme.desc: The Westman Islands are home to one of the largest colonies of puffins in the world! Once a year puffins return to the land to lay a single egg.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jet Academy: Symbiosis Shrink Down
programme.desc: The Go Jetters learn about 'symbiosis' - when two different animals or plants help each other.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: When a Railway Show for little engines comes to Sodor, an overly excited Percy finally sees his chance to shine.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Big Sleepover
programme.desc: The little girl and her feathery friend have a sleepover with some friends, but struggle to get to nod off.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Duck's Quack
programme.desc: Sarah suggests visiting the spare sounds section of the Big Shop when Duck loses his quack.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - House
programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - You're Never Too Old
programme.desc: Monty is picked on at school for keeping his cuddly toys, and thinks he may be too old for them. This leads him to think about whether people can ever be too old to play.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to See a Rainbow
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran get caught in the rain at the park and shelter under the bandstand. JoJo spots a rainbow and discovers that rainbows are only visible when it's rainy and sunny at the same time.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Grand Canyon, USA
programme.desc: Kyan is completing his 'GoJet Academy' high-wire training, above the Grand Canyon, but he's not the only wire-walker out there...

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Strawberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure, but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Runner Beans
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the speedy dancing runner beans!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Operation Kiwi
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Museum Mischief
programme.desc: Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Tickly
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - G
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'g', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We rock out on the guitar, meet a goat and score a goal!

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Pop Goes Circus
programme.desc: The friends are joining Hooper's circus school. But when Plom struggles to find a skill he's good at, will he be able to earn his circus school certificate?

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - The Sun in a Bucket
programme.desc: When the sun mysteriously disappears, Messy and his friends zoom up to space to find out what's going on and bump into some old friends.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Tickly
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Like legendary director Chu Yuan did so often and so successfully, Chang Peng Yi adapted this film from a story by Ku Lung. Following the footsteps of the equally legendary Chang Cheh, Chang also casted the majestic Ti Lung, along with "Venoms" Lo Meng and Sun Chien, for a spectacular showcase of mystical Martial Arts World's intrigue and consummate Kung Fu.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, Three Sinners is a Huangmei Opera about love, betrayal, murder, and redemption. Starring Hong Kong's premiere movie couple, it is one of the grandest Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musicals in the Shaw Brothers library.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Adapted from the renowned Chinese novel, The Water Margin, this is the story of a poor and beautiful girl Lotus Pan, who is raped by her master and had to be married off to a midget who treats her badly. Lost and lonely, Pan unwittingly becomes a pawn in the game of lust between her husband's playboy brother Wu Song, and a murderous man Men Ching.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what's relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world's top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".

programme.title: The World Today

programme.title: The Vibe
programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The content focuses on exciting new trends, fashion, and cultural topics across a range of disciplines both in China and abroad. The host presents various culture-related topics in a fun way while also doing some in-depth analysis to give viewers a fuller picture as to what is happening, and why it matters.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN's English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a "No-Paperworkist" movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Chicago
programme.desc: Boss and family go on Spring Break to visit his grandparents in the big city of Chicago. Boss uses the trip to test his business mettle, by getting in a promotion war at a real big adult company. And when a department store refuses to let Gigi and Tim return an item, they wind up unionizing the entire sales force.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Crazy Caustic Spray of the Contagious Cruelius Sneezer
programme.desc: In order to spice up their field trip to Romeinday (an ancient Rome reenactment park), George and Harold trick Melvin into turning the bus into a time machine so they can travel to actual ancient Rome and be gladiators. After offending Caesar with their comic, the emperor is accidentally turned into Cruelius Sneezer and pursues the school group with all his might.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Trashy Tale of the Tumultuous Tubbadump
programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. But Melvin creates an invention to suck all the trash into another dimension. The plan backfires when Tubbadump, a trash-covered monster, emerges from that dimension for revenge on the trashmakers.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Last Auction Heroes
programme.desc: When the Riders uncover the location of Viggo's Dragon Auction, they must stop him from selling dragons and stealing all the gold in Berk.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Defenders Of The Wing Part 1
programme.desc: The Defenders of the Wing are a local island tribe, which worships dragons and believe the Riders have stolen their protector - the Eruptodon dragon.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - A New Defender
programme.desc: Victory is almost within reach of the Voltron Coalition, but after a setback has the team trapped, their only hope for survival comes in the most unexpected way

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Thunk O'clock High The Croo-Gitive
programme.desc: Thunk must face a bully that's notorious for being an animalThe Croods flee after Grug is accused of robbing caves and stealing food for the Broods

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Wayward Wedding
programme.desc: Jim and Kate are getting married... or are they?

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Pteracopters
programme.desc: When Pteracopterscrash land in the Flatirons, Ty and crew must go behind enemy lines to save their fallen wingman from savage STEALTH SCRAPADACTYLS

programme.desc: Raa Raa has spotted an exciting new thing in the jungle. What could it be? As they try to get close to the "flappy fly", Raa Raa discovers that some situations call for absolute quiet… not something our noisy little lion is very good at!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - The Right Sound
programme.desc: One of the pipes on Huffty's Toot Stick has broken. Can Raa Raa help his friend find the "right" sound to replace it in the jungle so they can play loud music together?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Huffty Loses His Voice
programme.desc: Huffty has lost his voice. While Raa Raa and his friends try and work out what has happened to it, Huffty has to mime to make himself understood.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa Finds A Voice
programme.desc: Raa Raa is upset when Topsy suggests that he should stick to doing "Raa Raa" things. He sets out to prove Topsy wrong. Will the noisy little lion learn that sometimes it's best just to be yourself?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Zebby's Snack Time
programme.desc: Zebby likes to have a snack when she is feeling tired. Raa Raa thinks this is a great idea and decides to join his friend. Except he thinks they should have their snack in the perfect place… but everywhere they try is just too noisy… I wonder why that could be?!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Finding Noisy
programme.desc: Raa Raa gets carried away when collecting fun noisy objects in the jungle with his friends. Raa Raa wants to keep everything he finds for himself, but soon discovers that his collection isn't much fun with nobody to share it with.

programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch learn that Sandra Paws' sleigh broke down on a mountain, they have to go on an adventure to fix the sleigh and save Sniffs-mas! Meanwhile, Beans tries to get a grumpy Frank to feel the Sniffs-mas spirit.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Harmony Harbor's Holiday Surprise
programme.desc: When the townsfolk decorate the Harmony Harbor holiday tree but lose the treetop star, TZG secretly search for it in the yard of a notoriously scary house. When it transpires the house is not-so-scary after all and belongs to shy inventor Dr. Greenlittle, TZG secretly leads her to the big Harmony Harbor sing-along so that she doesn't have to spend the holiday alone.

programme.desc: George and Harold love Christmas, but they feel like it could use some upgrades. So they make a comic about a new version of the holiday: BLISSMAS. Instead of red bows, laser shows! Thanks to Tag’s handiness - and one of Lady Lydia’s hats - they make it to the party just in time. \ Pawston’s new canine mail carrier keeps getting chased by dogs, so Tag and Scooch have to help him deliver the mail.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Gabby Gets The Hiccups
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isn't until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Defenders
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates

Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back

However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit

Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back

Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling "Adult Babies" before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict "no-babies" policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Yellow 100
programme.desc: Finally promoted to CEO, Boss Baby sets his sights on achieving 100% Baby Love, while dealing with the annoying Puppies and Preeks who rented Baby Corp office space while Boss was gone. Tim and Danny become local heroes after saving a baby's life.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Pyg & Tam
programme.desc: Boss Baby encounters a new threat to Baby Love: an adorable Baby TV show starring Pyg the Pygmy Goat, Tam the Tamandua, and their host Maria-Maria. Boss is told not to go to Corporate War by Board Baby Emiliano, so Boss tries to provoke his enemies to make the first move.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Goodbye Crood World
programme.desc: When Phil detects a meteor is hurtling towards the farm, the Bettermans and Croods must decide how to spend their last day on earth.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Sticky Business
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phil’s perilous (and sticky) bounceberries.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Guy Time
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Magma Breather
programme.desc: Tom has to keep his mom, Olivia, distracted while Jun, Alex, and D’Angelo use a new dragon to close off a cave leading to the Crystal Realm, and prevent her from discovering the dragons.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragons of the Undead
programme.desc: When Feather is taken by a group of what appear to be zombie dragons, Alex finds her inner hero and rescues her friend.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Downpour
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder train a new species of aggressive tidal dragons to help the other riders put out a forest fire threatening ICARIS.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunder Misters
programme.desc: Jealous of the Thunder Sisters, the men on the farm undergo a series of difficult initiation rituals to try and join the exclusive tribe of women.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Eep Walking
programme.desc: Eep loves action and adventure - it's in her blood. But when Eep starts adventuring in her sleep, she has to try to find the cause of her new sleep walking to avoid ending up in dangerous situations.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - The Gorgwatch Project
programme.desc: After Thunk and Guy tell Eep and Dawn a campfire story of Gorgwatch, a hideous monster who roams the woods, the girls are terrified. After a sleepless night, Guy and Thunk assure the girls it's just a made up story. Dawn and Eep are relieved until they find proof that Gorgwatch is real... and he's coming for them.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Decoy
programme.desc: Tom’s leadership abilities come into question by Eugene when his decisions lead to failure while attempting to confront Buzzsaw.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunder’s home realm.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP11
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP31
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP31
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP20
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP16
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP17
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP40
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.
